scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run local:setup
scripts.lint: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const cp=require("child_process");for(const ws of ["mobile","backend","shared"]){if(fs.existsSync(ws+"/package.json")){cp.execSync("npm --workspace "+ws+" run lint --if-present",{stdio:"inherit"});}}'
scripts.test:ci:backend: node -e 'const cp=require("child_process");const env={...process.env};delete env.DATABASE_URL;cp.execSync("npm --workspace backend test",{stdio:"inherit",env});'
scripts.typecheck: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const cp=require("child_process");for(const ws of ["mobile","backend","shared"]){if(fs.existsSync(ws+"/package.json")){cp.execSync("npm --workspace "+ws+" run typecheck --if-present",{stdio:"inherit"});}}'
scripts.test: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const cp=require("child_process");for(const ws of ["mobile","backend","shared"]){if(fs.existsSync(ws+"/package.json")){cp.execSync("npm --workspace "+ws+" run test --if-present",{stdio:"inherit"});}}'
